items.heading: Nursing Is a Real, Regulated,
items.text: Nursing is a real, regulated, structurally in-demand clinical career in India, not a dressed-up "helping people" job with no ceiling. But "is nursing good" and "will the first few years feel good on your body and schedule" are two different questions, and most course brochures blur them together until you cannot tell which one is actually being answered.

items.heading: Most "Is Nursing a Good
items.text: Most "is nursing a good career" articles only talk about a BSc Nursing graduate's path. That skips the first real decision most Indian nursing aspirants actually face: which of the three legal entry routes to take, and why that choice shapes your ceiling for a decade or more.

items.heading: "Nursing Salary in India" Gets
items.text: "Nursing salary in India" gets quoted as a single flattering number far too often. The real spread between a private-hospital fresher and a government-placed, specialised senior nurse is large, and which side of that spread you land on depends more on employer type than on which entry route you took.
